name: @articals/logistics-functions
description: Trusted backend for Articals Logistics (multi-tenant logistics SaaS). Owns pricing, authorization, entitlements and reporting.

scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth,storage --project demo-articals "vitest run --project rules"
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:rules
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions
